exposure: coagulation parameters (fibrinogen, D-dimer, D-dimer/fibrinogen ratio, platelets, international normalised ratio (INR))
cohort: The study included 1342 pregnant women recruited in their third trimester.
finding: Low haemoglobin (Hb) and high international normalised ratio (INR) at the third trimester of pregnancy independently increased the odds of postpartum haemorrhage (PPH) at childbirth.
